title: Adult-Only Retail Training: A 2026 Vape Compliance Routine
searchIntent: Explain practical staff-training and recordkeeping habits for adult-only retailers selling tobacco products in the United States.
sourceName: U.S. FDA — Retail Sales of Tobacco Products
sourceFacts: FDA states that it is illegal for retailers to sell tobacco products, including e-cigarettes, to anyone under 21 in the United States.
FDA provides retailer education, compliance-check information and publicly searchable inspection information.
Online sales and promotion can be investigated; an absence from a database does not imply full compliance.
jurisdictionBoundary: Discuss U.S. federal information only; tell readers to check applicable state, local and market-specific requirements.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim any retailer or workflow guarantees compliance.
